description: news-console: session.start timers fetch origin in the background; prompt.submit adds one context line when behind; ui.render draws the AbovePrompt band and a PromptHint suffix; tool.call hooks on Read (freshness log line), Edit/Write (attribution) and Bash/PowerShell (attribution and the foreign-file stage guard). Every tool.call hook passes next(e) or returns { deny }; none returns { result }.
